layers.authority: Administración del Parque Provincial Ischigualasto (San Juan)
layers.process: Ischigualasto Provincial Park: the daytime traditional circuit (40 km, five stops, about 3 hours, done in vehicles) runs on arrival with no booking, with departures about every hour from 8:00 to 17:00. In hot months entries stop at 11:00 and resume at 16:00. Entry fees are not published on the park's own site, so none are recorded here.

layers.authority: Administración del Parque Provincial Ischigualasto (San Juan)
layers.process: Ischigualasto Provincial Park: the full-moon circuit (about 2.5 hours, ages 10 and over), the Cerro Morado walk (5.73 km, high difficulty), the Río Salado walk (ages 10 and over) and the mountain-bike circuit run by booking through the park's phone, WhatsApp or email contacts on its site, and depend on weather at the start. The full-moon circuit runs only four nights a month, around the lunar phase change.

public_holidays: 2027-06-13 (Sunday): Fundación de San Juan de la Frontera, a provincial holiday (Ley 14-P, article 83).
2027-09-11 (Saturday): Fundación de San Juan de la Frontera, included as a feriado among the dates referred to in article 81 (Ley 14-P, article 82).
culture-cycles.note: Ley 14-P (CONMEMORACIONES, FERIADOS Y DÍAS NO LABORABLES), sanctioned 19 November 2014 and published in the Boletín Oficial on 16 March 2015, was read in the official national compilation of provincial law (texto actualizado) on 11 November 2026. Article 81 applies the Nation's feriados and días no laborables in the province. Articles 82 and 83 add the two foundation dates above as feriados. Other commemorative days in the same law (including Semana Sarmientina, Día del Árbol as a named day in article 4, 24 April as an adhesion to national Law 26.199, and 30 May as Día Provincial del Inspector de Minas) are not themselves declared feriados and are not recorded here as public holidays. This record does not restate national weekend-observance rules for years when 13 June or 11 September falls on a weekend. Later amendments after the compiled text were not checked.
